title: PardoGarcia2026: Mu/beta motor-imagery EEG in chronic MCA stroke and healthy controls
description: This dataset contains EEG recorded during image-cued, two-class hand motor imagery and preparation (precision pinch versus closed fist) in chronic middle cerebral artery (MCA) stroke patients and healthy controls. It includes baseline and post-rehabilitation sessions for stroke patients and a single baseline session for healthy controls. Recordings comprise 63 BrainVision channels sampled at 1000 Hz. The data support investigation of mu and beta oscillatory changes (event-related desynchronization) associated with motor imagery and rehabilitation.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainVision system (63 channels, 10-10 montage, Ag/AgCl electrodes, 1000 Hz, right mastoid reference). Participants viewed a cue image of a precision pinch or closed fist and imagined and prepared that grip, with overt execution following a later auditory go cue. Only the pre-execution interval (0-1.5 s) is exposed. Stroke patients were recorded before and after rehabilitation.
